content_sections.heading: About IMU Kochi
content_sections.text: Indian Maritime University is a Central University of the Government of India. The notice is issued by its Kochi Campus at SERA, NH-966B, Matsyapuri (P.O), Kochi-682 029.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 2 vacancies.

rows.post: Faculty (Logistics and Supply Chain Management) – On Contract

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: MBA in Logistics and Supply Chain Management / Transportation Management / International Business or equivalent PG degree from a recognized Indian University or an accredited foreign University, with a minimum of 55% marks. OR M.Com in Logistics and Supply Chain Management / Transportation Management / International Business or equivalent PG degree, from a recognized Indian University or an accredited foreign University, with a minimum of 55% marks. For the UG degree, relevance will be assessed by the Selection Committee, whose decision is final. Age limit: Not exceeding 60 years, as on 04.11.2026. A 2-year relaxation in the upper age limit is given in the case of a deserving candidate.

rows.qualification: Essential: (a) Graduation from a recognized University with a good academic record; (b) MBA or M.Com as listed below; (c) PhD in the relevant field OR NET by the UGC OR SLET/SET
rows.experience: Essential: 2 years of teaching experience in UG and/or PG programmes in the relevant subjects

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The proposed remuneration is commensurate with qualifications and experience. No amount is printed in the notice. Contract period: an initial period of six months, with the possibility of extensions every six months based on necessity and satisfactory performance. The period of engagement will be a minimum of six months starting from Jan / February 2027 or as intimated by IMU Kochi Campus. The contract engagement can be terminated at one month's notice by either side.

content_sections.heading: IMU Kochi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the nature of responsibilities as: teaching/instructing BBA and MBA students, providing project guidance, handling examination-related tasks, assisting the placement cell, coordinating management events, mentoring and fulfilling additional responsibilities as assigned by the Head of Department / Campus Director.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is interview. Eligibility alone does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The University reserves the right to further shortlist eligible candidates based on qualifications, relevant experience and other applicable criteria. Only those who rank highest in the shortlisting process will be called for the interview, and they will be notified of the interview date by email.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Kochi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the attached application format; applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected. Enclose photocopies of all supporting documents, certificates and testimonials. Send the hard copy by Registered/Speed post, on or before 5 December 2026, to: Deputy Registrar (i/c), Indian Maritime University, Kochi Campus, South End Reclamation Area, NH-966B, Matsyapuri P.O., Kochi - 682 029. Also send a soft copy of the application electronically to [email protected] . Both hard copy and soft copy are required. Applications received without the hard copy will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Photocopies of all supporting documents, certificates and testimonials, sent with the application. For shortlisted candidates at the interview: all original documents, certificates and testimonials submitted earlier, with one set of xerox copies, for physical verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates to attend the interview. Applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many Faculty vacancies are there in IMU Kochi?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Faculty (Logistics and Supply Chain Management) on contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 5 December 2026. The application must be sent on or before this date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Graduation, plus an MBA or M.Com in the listed fields (or equivalent PG degree) with minimum 55% marks, plus a PhD in the relevant field or UGC NET or SLET/SET. Two years of UG and/or PG teaching experience is also essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 60 years as on 04.11.2026. A 2-year relaxation in the upper age limit is given in the case of a deserving candidate.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format with photocopies of documents by Registered/Speed post to the Deputy Registrar (i/c), and also email a soft copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Will an application without a hard copy be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications received without the hard copy shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview. The University may first shortlist eligible candidates, and only the highest-ranked shortlisted candidates are called.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract post for an initial six months, with possible extensions every six months, and either side can end it with one month's notice.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. When does the engagement start?
faq.answer: The minimum six-month engagement starts from Jan / February 2027 or as intimated by IMU Kochi Campus.
